name: assistant
summary: An assistant thread: user bubbles, answers with a folded reasoning trace and actions, and a composer with mentions, attachments and a model picker.
ports: turns: the conversation as Turn[] (id, from, parts), oldest first; map useChat messages onto it
status, onStop: useChat status and stop; the composer turns send into stop while a reply streams
onSend: (message) => sendMessage, with the mentions and files beside the text; a rejection restores the draft
onRegenerate, onDecide, onNew: regenerate a turn, answer a tool approval, start an empty chat
mentions: the suppliers and parts @ lists, grouped options or a loader
models: the grouped models the picker offers
